title: 汽車噪音振動舒適度
summary: 從感測器安裝到階次追蹤，將聲音、振動、主觀感受與結構模式分開。
summaryEn: Follow mounting through order tracking, separating sound, vibration, subjective impression and structural modes.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創汽車與交通工具教學。所有數值均為明示假設，不是同名車輛的實測規格、認證或維修設定。使用試算表、紙面圖、合成資料及自行準備的離線模型；不提供真實高壓、道路、壓力設備或控制器操作授權。
scopeEn: Original automotive teaching based on public principles. All numerical inputs are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vehicle specifications, certification criteria or maintenance settings. Use worksheets, paper diagrams, synthetic data and offline models you prepare; no authorization for real high-voltage, road, pressure-equipment or controller operations.

steps.title: 取樣頻率與最高分析頻率：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Sampling and analysis bandwidth: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 取樣頻率與最高分析頻率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Sampling and analysis bandwidth and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 本課觀察對象為加速度計、麥克風與轉速參考。Nyquist界限是理想帶限重建必要條件；實務需抗混疊濾波與過渡帶。
steps.instructionEn: This course follows accelerometers, microphones and speed references. Nyquist is a necessary ideal bandlimited condition; practical acquisition needs anti-alias filtering and a transition band.
steps.observation: 獨立教學工況，非原廠或實測規格；跨單元整合須先統一輸入及分配邊界：fNyquist=fs/2；fs=1000 Hz；計算結果=500 Hz。
steps.observationEn: Independent teaching operating point, not OEM or measured specifications; reconcile inputs and allocation boundaries before cross-unit integration: fNyquist=fs/2; fs=1000 Hz; result=500 Hz.
steps.failure: 高頻雜訊可能折返為低頻故障；先看濾波和取樣設定。
steps.failureEn: High-frequency noise may alias into a low-frequency fault; inspect filters and sampling first.
steps.check: Nyquist為500 Hz；不能宣稱可可靠量測剛好500 Hz的所有相位訊號。 將此判讀連回加速度計、麥克風與轉速參考的資料，記錄量測位置、邊界與資料版本。
steps.checkEn: Nyquist is 500 Hz; this does not guarantee reliable measurement at exactly 500 Hz for every phase. Relate this interpretation to accelerometers, microphones and speed references and record measurement locations, boundaries and data version.

steps.instruction: 本課觀察對象為加速度計、麥克風與轉速參考。RMS衡量均方振動量；頻帶、方向與加權必須一致，不能直接代表主觀舒適。
